integrity: All asserted limits are supported by an analytic blocking and exponential-coupling argument; standalone code supplies independent finite checks, not proof of infinite convergence.
scientific_limitations: Uniform circular sites only; fixed exceedance height; no density universality or optimality of the error rate claimed. Classical unmarked extreme m-spacings precede this work. Exact first-public day of older bibliographic sources was not established.
title: Marked extremes of circular one-dimensional Voronoi cells
